plans.buy_case: DOW is flashing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI 28.5 (oversold), Bollinger Band squeeze with MACD turning up, AND a bullish RSI divergence (price made a lower low but RSI made a higher low—classic reversal signal). Price is above the 200MA with a golden cross in place, giving you a clean technical structure for a swing trade.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip to 25–26 OR price to touch the lower Bollinger Band (~$34.20). Do NOT chase at current levels. This is a squeeze breakout; you want confirmation of the reversal, not entry into the setup.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at RSI >70 or price hits $37.50 (short-term resistance). Hard stop below $33.80 (breaks 200MA and invalidates the setup). Also exit if MACD histogram rolls over or BB width expands sharply without upside follow-through.
plans.risk: Basic materials are cyclical and sentiment-driven—a macro pullback or earnings miss kills momentum fast. You have no recent news/earnings context, which is a blind spot. VIX is calm now, but a spike could unwind this setup. Position size ($212) is tiny, but if DOW breaks below support hard, you're down 5%+ quickly.

plans.buy_case: CTVA is flashing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI deep in oversold (24.1), price pinned to lower Bollinger Band with a squeeze active, and MACD histogram turning up off the valley. However, the 'low confidence' flag on fundamentals is a real concern—you need to verify the earnings outlook and sector tailwinds before committing.

plans.buy_case: WELL is firing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI 27.3 (oversold), price kissing lower Bollinger Band, MACD turning at valley, and above 200MA—classic swing bounce candidates. The golden cross (50MA > 200MA) provides upside bias, and VIX is calm enough to avoid whipsaw. However, this is a $3.2k portfolio with limited dry powder—position sizing must be disciplined.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on first close above $201.50 (upper BB rejection zone) OR if RSI dips to 23–24 with volume confirmation. Avoid FOMO chasing; wait for one of these two conditions to trigger, or pass.
plans.exit_condition: Sell 50% at RSI 65–70 (overbought) around $209–211, full exit if price breaks below 200MA (191.20) or RSI falls back into 40–45 zone without upside follow-through. Cut loss if drops below $194.
plans.risk: WELL is healthcare real estate—exposed to occupancy/reimbursement risks and rising rates. Limited recent news makes fundamental validation impossible; if next earnings disappoint, this could gap down hard. At $200 position size, you're risking ~2–3% of portfolio, which is acceptable, but don't add if it goes against you.
plans.additional_note: Before buying: spend 30 min reviewing latest earnings report, occupancy trends, and debt levels. If fundamentals are sketchy, skip this—your edge is technical, but WELL's cycle matters. $1 position is smart for a $3.2k portfolio; don't overtrade.
